يعلولون (form XII)
# يَعْلَوْلُونَ (yaʕlawlūna) /jaʕ.law.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
# يُعْلَوْلَوْنَ (yuʕlawlawna) /juʕ.law.law.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
